sources.entry: drawDB - Browser-based visual and DBML database diagram editor and SQL generator for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MariaDB, MSSQL and Oracle. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: drawDB is a browser-based database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that generates and imports SQL scripts, with no account required.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes drawDB as a free, simple database schema editor and SQL generator that runs in the browser. Users build ERD diagrams, export and import SQL scripts, and generate migrations. The editor can be customized and works without creating an account. Optional file sharing needs a separate server configured through environment variables described in .env.sample. The README's Docker section shows how to run the app locally on port 3000 and how to point a prebuilt image at a backend URL. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as supporting DBML and MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MariaDB, MSSQL and Oracle.
use_cases: generate SQL scripts from a diagram
import existing SQL into an ERD
share database diagrams with a team
notable: Runs entirely in the browser with no account required
Exports and imports SQL scripts and generates migrations
Supports DBML as well as several SQL dialects
Backend URL can be set at Docker run time without rebuilding the image
caveats: File sharing requires separate server setup and environment variables; it is optional
The README does not list which SQL dialects are supported beyond the awesome-selfhosted listing
